title: Crispy Turkey and Fiesta Fiesta Neck Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on traditional stir-fry, using turkey neck for added flavor and crispy texture.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the turkey neck pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the turkey breast, fiesta corn, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Stir-fry until the turkey is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and garnish with green onions if desired.
To crisp the turkey neck, heat an additional 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the browned turkey neck pieces and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Serve the crispy turkey neck on top of the stir-fry or on the side.
Optional: serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
